description_en: Saves output details in batch as personal resources. Supports link or copy mode
description_zh: 将产出明细批量保存为个人资源，支持链接或复制模式
name: SaveOutputFileToResource

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass it explicitly with --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The save mode. Valid values:
link: Links the resource to the output in a 1:1 idempotent manner. Edits to the output are synchronized to the resource.
copy: Creates a snapshot copy with no limit on the number of copies
parameters.help_zh: 保存方式：link=链接（1:1 幂等，编辑产出会同步资源） / copy=复制（不限次，快照）
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target personal folder. If not specified, the user's default folder is automatically resolved
parameters.help_zh: 目标个人目录 ID；不传则自动解析用户默认目录
parameters.name: directory_id

200.description_en: 将产出明细批量保存为个人资源（link / copy）
200.description_zh: 将产出明细批量保存为个人资源（link / copy）

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A failure returns a backend error code (ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*)
code.description_zh: 业务状态码：成功为 200，失败为后端错误码（ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*）

message.description_en: The error description. This value is empty on success
message.example: The current zone list is illegal.

results.description_en: The per-record results in the same order as the input itemIds. A single record failure does not affect other records
results.description_zh: 逐条结果，与入参 itemIds 同序；单条失败不影响其他条

errorCode.description_en: The business error code (i18n key). Returned on failure
errorCode.description_zh: 失败时返回业务错误码（i18n key）
errorCode.title_en: 失败时返回业务错误码（i18n key）
errorCode.title_zh: 失败时返回业务错误码（i18n key）

errorMessage.description_en: The error description, localized based on the request Accept-Language header. Returned on failure
errorMessage.description_zh: 失败时返回错误描述（已按请求 locale 国际化）

errorMessage.title_zh: 失败时返回错误描述（已按请求 `Accept-Language` 国际化）

sourceId.description_en: The sourceId of the newly created resource. Returned on success
